views.name: v_member_details
views.create_sql: CREATE VIEW v_member_details AS SELECT member.member_id, member.first_name, member.last_name, member.email, member.position, member.t_shirt_size, member.phone, major.major_name, major.department AS major_department, major.college AS major_college, zip_code.city, zip_code.county, zip_code.state, member.zip, member.link_to_major, major.major_id, zip_code.zip_code, zip_code.type, zip_code.short_state FROM member LEFT JOIN major ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id LEFT JOIN zip_code ON member.zip = zip_code.zip_code

views.name: v_event_budget
views.create_sql: CREATE VIEW v_event_budget AS SELECT budget.budget_id, budget.category AS budget_category, budget.amount AS budget_amount, budget.spent AS budget_spent, budget.remaining AS budget_remaining, event.event_id, event.event_name, event.event_date, event.type AS event_type, event.location AS event_location, event.status AS event_status, budget.event_status AS budget_event_status, budget.link_to_event, event.notes FROM budget LEFT JOIN event ON budget.link_to_event = event.event_id

views.name: v_expense_details
views.create_sql: CREATE VIEW v_expense_details AS SELECT expense.expense_id, expense.expense_description, expense.expense_date, expense.cost, expense.approved, member.first_name AS member_first_name, member.last_name AS member_last_name, budget.category AS budget_category, event.event_name, expense.link_to_member, expense.link_to_budget, budget.budget_id, budget.spent, budget.remaining, budget.amount, budget.event_status, budget.link_to_event, event.event_id, event.event_date, event.type, event.notes, event.location, event.status, member.member_id, member.email, member.position, member.t_shirt_size, member.phone, member.zip, member.link_to_major FROM expense LEFT JOIN budget ON expense.link_to_budget = budget.budget_id LEFT JOIN event ON budget.link_to_event = event.event_id LEFT JOIN member ON expense.link_to_member = member.member_id

views.name: v_attendance
views.create_sql: CREATE VIEW v_attendance AS SELECT attendance.link_to_event, attendance.link_to_member, member.member_id, member.first_name, member.last_name, member.email, member.position, member.t_shirt_size, member.phone, member.zip, member.link_to_major, event.event_id, event.event_name, event.event_date, event.type, event.notes, event.location, event.status FROM attendance LEFT JOIN member ON attendance.link_to_member = member.member_id LEFT JOIN event ON attendance.link_to_event = event.event_id

views.name: v_income
views.create_sql: CREATE VIEW v_income AS SELECT income.income_id, income.date_received, income.amount, income.source, income.notes, income.link_to_member, member.member_id, member.first_name, member.last_name, member.email, member.position, member.t_shirt_size, member.phone, member.zip, member.link_to_major FROM income LEFT JOIN member ON income.link_to_member = member.member_id
